BillHeading.BriefDescription: Relating to addressing the educator shortage and diversifying the educator workforce by supporting future educators from local communities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to addressing the educator shortage and diversifying the educator workforce by supporting future educators from local communities; and creating a new section.

BillSectionHeader.P: This act may be known and cited as the addressing the educator shortage and diversifying the educator workforce by supporting future educators from local communities act.
